svg.title: Field lines of a charged insulating rod
svg.desc: Computed field lines of a diagonal insulating rod whose positive charges are crowded near its upper-right end, with a few in the middle and one at the lower-left end. Lines start on the charges and run outward. They are dense around the heavily charged upper end and sparse elsewhere. Lines leaving the middle and lower parts of the rod do not leave at right angles: they are pushed away from the crowded upper end and tilt downward along the rod. Far from the rod the lines spread out radially, as from a single positive charge.
